about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice B): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Malaysian Jam and Butter Toast Fingers with Soy Eggs
recipes.summary: Thick toast layered with sweet jam and butter, served with gently cooked eggs and a splash of soy and pepper.
steps: Bring a small pot of water to a gentle boil, lower in the eggs and cook for 6 minutes until the whites are set and the yolks are jammy, then cool in cold water for 1 minute and peel.
Toast the bread in a toaster or dry pan until golden and crisp on both sides, about 3 minutes.
Spread two slices with the jam and the other two with the cold butter, then sandwich together and press lightly until the butter starts to soften.
Crack the eggs into a shallow bowl, add the soy sauce and pepper and break up lightly with a fork until saucy.
Cut the toast into fingers and serve with the eggs for dipping until the plate is clean.
notes: Food safety: cook eggs until the whites are fully set; do not serve to anyone at risk with runny yolks.
Tip: the jam is sweet, so go easy on the soy sauce.

recipes.title: Nasi Lemak Egg Breakfast Wraps
recipes.summary: Coconut rice, sambal and a crisp fried egg rolled in a flatbread for a portable take on the classic breakfast.
steps: Rinse the rice, then simmer with the coconut milk, water and 1/2 tsp salt in a covered pot over low heat for 15 minutes until the liquid is absorbed and the rice is tender and fluffy. Rest covered for 5 minutes.
Heat the oil in a non-stick pan over medium-high heat and fry the eggs for 2 to 3 minutes until the whites are crisp at the edges and fully set.
Warm the flatbreads in a dry pan for 20 seconds a side until soft and pliable.
Spread each flatbread with a spoonful of sambal, then add coconut rice, a fried egg, sliced cucumber and peanuts.
Fold in the sides and roll up tightly, then serve warm.
notes: Food safety: cook eggs until the whites are fully set.
Tip: sambal oelek is hot, so start with 1 tbsp for a milder wrap.

recipes.title: Roti Jala Lace Pancakes with Curry Dip
recipes.summary: Delicate net-like crepes poured from a squeeze bottle and rolled around a mild, spiced potato and pea curry.
steps: Whisk the flour, egg, coconut milk, water, turmeric and 1/2 tsp salt until completely smooth and the consistency of thin cream. Rest for 10 minutes, then pour into a squeeze bottle with a few small holes.
Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat. Fry the chopped onion for 5 minutes until soft, stir in the curry powder for 30 seconds until fragrant, then add the potato and 1 1/2 cups water.
Simmer for 15 minutes, mashing a few pieces of potato, until the potato is tender and the curry is thick. Stir in the peas for the last 2 minutes until bright green.

Heat a non-stick pan over medium-low heat and lightly grease. Squeeze the batter in a circular lacy pattern and cook for 1 minute until set and the underside is pale, with no browning. Do not flip. Slide out and repeat with the remaining batter.
Fold each lace pancake into a quarter and serve with the curry.
notes: Food safety: make sure the batter is cooked through and refrigerate leftover curry within 2 hours.
Tip: the pan must be hot enough to set the batter at once but not so hot that the lace colours.

recipes.title: Nasi Kerabu Style Herb Rice Breakfast Bowls
recipes.summary: Fragrant rice tossed with herbs, served with a salty coconut topping, soft egg and crisp cucumber.
steps: Cook the rice with 1 1/2 cups water in a covered pot over low heat for 15 minutes until tender and fluffy, then rest for 5 minutes.
Toast the desiccated coconut in a dry pan over medium heat for 3 minutes, stirring, until golden. Tip into a bowl and mix with the soy sauce.
Boil the eggs for 8 minutes until the yolks are just set, cool in cold water, then peel and halve.
Finely slice the coriander and mint, then slice the cucumber into thin matchsticks.
Toss the warm rice with the herbs, oil and the juice of half the lime until the grains are speckled green. Spoon into bowls.
Top with the eggs, cucumber and toasted coconut mixture, and serve with the remaining lime in wedges.
notes: Food safety: boil eggs until firm and refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.

recipes.title: Sambal Egg Wraps with Crisp Onion
recipes.summary: Soft eggs cooked in a quick sambal base, rolled in warm roti with crisp fried onion.
steps: Heat the oil in a frying pan over medium heat. Slice half the onion thinly and fry for 4 minutes until deep golden and crisp, then lift out onto paper towel.
Chop the remaining onion and cook in the pan for 3 minutes until soft, then add the diced tomato and sambal and cook for 3 minutes until thick and saucy.
Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt, pour over the sauce and stir gently for 2 minutes until just set and creamy.
Warm the roti in a dry pan for 30 seconds a side until soft and flecked with brown.
Spoon the egg onto the roti, scatter over the crisp onion, roll up and serve warm.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until set throughout.

recipes.title: Jakarta Style Turmeric Chicken Rice Porridge with Egg
recipes.summary: Silky rice porridge cooked with ginger, topped with shredded turmeric chicken, fried shallot and a soft egg.
steps: Combine the rice, water, ginger, garlic and 1 tsp salt in a large pot. Bring to the boil until bubbling, then reduce to a low simmer.
Add the chicken and turmeric and simmer gently for 25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through (at least 75°C). Lift out the chicken and shred with two forks.
Keep simmering the rice for 15 to 20 minutes, stirring often, until it breaks down into a thick, creamy porridge. Add hot water if it gets too thick.
Boil the eggs for 7 minutes until jammy, cool and peel.
Ladle the porridge into bowls and top with the shredded chicken, halved egg, soy sauce, spring onion and a drizzle of the oil.
notes: Food safety: cook chicken to 75°C and eat porridge hot; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and reheat until steaming.
Tip: stir the porridge from the bottom often as it catches easily.

recipes.title: Kolak Pumpkin Coconut Breakfast Pots
recipes.summary: Sweet pumpkin and sweet potato simmered in coconut milk with palm sugar and warm spice, served warm.
steps: Combine the water, coconut milk, brown sugar, cinnamon and salt in a pot and bring to a gentle simmer, stirring until the sugar dissolves.
Add the pumpkin and sweet potato and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes, until both are tender when pierced with a fork and the liquid has thickened slightly.
Remove the cinnamon stick and ladle into bowls. Serve warm.
notes: Tip: keep the heat low so the coconut milk does not split.
Vegan.

recipes.title: Pisang-Free Sweet Potato Pancakes with Coconut Syrup
recipes.summary: Soft rice flour pancakes made with sweet potato, drizzled with warm palm sugar coconut syrup.
steps: Peel and boil the sweet potato for 12 minutes until very tender, then drain and mash smooth.
Beat the mash with the rice flour, egg and half the coconut milk until a thick batter forms.
Heat the coconut oil in a non-stick pan over medium-low heat. Cook 1/4 cup scoops of batter for 3 minutes a side, until golden and cooked through.
Simmer the brown sugar, water and remaining coconut milk for 5 minutes until syrupy.
Stack the pancakes and spoon over the warm syrup.
notes: Food safety: cook until set in the centre.

recipes.title: Mandazi Spiced Coconut Breakfast Fingers
recipes.summary: Lightly sweet cardamom doughnut fingers fried until puffed and golden, served with warm tea.
steps: Whisk the flour, baking powder, sugar, cardamom and 1/2 tsp salt in a bowl, make a well and add the coconut milk and egg.
Mix to a soft dough and knead for 3 minutes on a floured bench until smooth and no longer sticky. Cover and rest for 10 minutes.
Roll out to 1cm thick and cut into fingers.
Heat the oil in a deep frying pan to 175°C (a cube of bread browns in about 30 seconds). Fry in batches for 2 minutes a side until puffed and deep golden.
Drain on paper towel and serve warm.
notes: Food safety: take care with hot oil; cook until golden and cooked through.
Plus 10 minutes resting.

recipes.title: Kampala Street Rolex Omelette Wraps
recipes.summary: Street-style omelette rolled in a soft chapati with cabbage and tomato.
steps: Finely shred the cabbage, dice the tomatoes and slice the onion.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat. Cook the onion and cabbage for 3 minutes until just soft, then add the tomato and 1/2 tsp salt and cook for 1 minute.
Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt. Pour a quarter into a clean oiled pan, swirl, and cook for 2 minutes until set. Fold in a quarter of the vegetables. Repeat to make 4 omelettes.
Warm the chapati in a dry pan for 20 seconds a side until soft and flecked with brown.
Lay an omelette on each chapati, roll up tightly and serve hot until steaming.
notes: Food safety: cook the omelettes until fully set and eat promptly.

recipes.title: Kenyan Spiced Sweet Potato Mash Breakfast Bowls
recipes.summary: Mashed sweet potato and kidney bean with coconut, topped with a fried egg and tomato.
steps: Peel and cube the sweet potato and boil for 15 minutes until very tender. Drain and mash with the coconut milk and 1/2 tsp salt until smooth.
Heat half the oil in a pan and stir the beans with the cumin for 3 minutes until hot and fragrant. Fold into the mash.
Heat the remaining oil and fry the sliced tomato for 2 minutes until softened.
Fry the eggs in the same pan for 3 minutes until the whites are firm.
Spoon the mash into bowls and top with tomato and a fried egg.
notes: Food safety: cook eggs until the whites are firm.

recipes.title: Ethiopian Spiced Scrambled Eggs with Flatbread
recipes.summary: Soft eggs cooked with onion, tomato and warming spice, scooped up with warm flatbread.
steps: Melt the butter in a frying pan over medium heat. Cook the diced onion for 4 minutes until soft and golden.
Add the paprika and cumin and stir for 30 seconds until fragrant, then add the chopped tomato and cook for 3 minutes until saucy.
Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt, pour in and stir gently for 2 minutes until softly set.
Warm the flatbread in a dry pan until soft and serve alongside.
notes: Food safety: cook eggs until set; do not use cracked eggs.

recipes.title: Rusk Dipping Porridge with Cinnamon Milk
recipes.summary: Warm maize porridge finished with cinnamon milk and crunchy toasted almond topping.
steps: Toast the flaked almonds in a dry pan for 3 minutes until golden, then set aside.
Bring the milk and water to a gentle simmer in a heavy pot. Whisk in the polenta in a thin stream until smooth.
Cook on low heat for 12 minutes, stirring often, until thick and creamy.
Stir in the sugar and cinnamon and divide into bowls. Top with the almonds.
notes: Tip: add extra milk for a looser porridge.

recipes.title: Eggs Bobotie Breakfast Cups
recipes.summary: Mini curried mince cups topped with an egg custard layer, baked until set.
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C and lightly oil a 4-cup muffin tin. Soak the bread in the milk.

Fry the onion in the oil for 5 minutes until soft, add the mince and curry powder and cook for 6 minutes until browned and cooked through. Stir in the jam and squeezed bread, mixing until moist and thick.
Divide among 4 large muffin cups, pressing down firmly.
Bake for 10 minutes. Crack an egg over each and bake for 8 to 10 minutes until the whites are fully set and the mince is at least 75°C.
Rest for 3 minutes, then lift out and serve warm.
notes: Food safety: cook mince to 75°C and eggs until set.

recipes.title: Mielie Fritters with Cinnamon and Honey
recipes.summary: Sweet corn fritters pan-fried until golden and served with cinnamon honey.
steps: Whisk the flour, baking powder and a pinch of salt in a bowl. Beat in the eggs and milk until a thick batter forms, then fold in the corn.
Heat the oil in a frying pan over medium heat. Drop in spoonfuls of batter and cook for 3 minutes a side until golden and cooked through.
Warm the honey with the cinnamon for 1 minute until runny.
Stack the fritters and drizzle over the cinnamon honey.
notes: Food safety: cook until set in the middle.

recipes.title: Samoan Panikeke Coconut Banana-Free Pancakes
recipes.summary: Soft coconut pancakes cooked in a pan and served with warm lime syrup.
steps: Whisk the flour, baking powder, 1 tbsp of the sugar and a pinch of salt in a bowl. Add the egg, coconut milk and water and whisk until just smooth.
Heat the oil in a non-stick pan over medium-low heat and ladle in 1/4 cup batter per pancake. Cook for 3 minutes until bubbles form, flip and cook for 2 minutes until golden.
Simmer the remaining sugar with the lime juice and 2 tbsp water for 3 minutes until syrupy.
Stack the pancakes and spoon over the syrup.
notes: Food safety: cook until set.

recipes.title: Hawaiian Coconut Sweet Bread Toast
recipes.summary: Thick slices of bread griddled with coconut egg custard and topped with warm pineapple.
steps: Whisk the eggs, coconut milk and cinnamon in a shallow dish.
Melt the butter in a frying pan over medium heat. Soak the bread in the mixture for 20 seconds a side, then fry for 3 minutes a side until golden and set in the middle.
Warm the drained pineapple in the pan for 2 minutes until just caramelised.
Serve the toast topped with the pineapple while hot and golden.
notes: Food safety: cook until the custard is set.

recipes.title: Fijian Cassava Coconut Pan Cakes
recipes.summary: Cassava flour batter fried into golden coconut cakes with a crisp edge.
steps: Stir the cassava flour with the coconut, coconut milk, sugar, egg, 1/4 cup water and a pinch of salt into a thick batter that holds a shape.
Heat the oil in a frying pan over medium heat. Spoon the batter into flat cakes and cook for 5 minutes a side until deeply golden and cooked through.
Drain on paper towel and serve warm.
notes: Food safety: cook cassava thoroughly, never eat it raw; cook until tender throughout.

recipes.title: Okinawan Sweet Potato Yoghurt Parfait Bowls
recipes.summary: Baked purple-fleshed sweet potato with yoghurt, honey and crunchy sesame oats.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Bake the sweet potatoes for 40 minutes until a knife slides in easily. Cool for 10 minutes.
Toast the oats and sesame in a dry pan for 4 minutes until golden and fragrant.
Mash the sweet potato flesh and spoon into bowls. Top with yoghurt, honey and the oat mixture.
notes: Tip: bake the potatoes the night before to save time.

recipes.title: Japanese Soy Egg Toasties
recipes.summary: Soft egg mixed with soy and mayo, griddled in buttered bread until golden.
steps: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes until firm, cool in cold water, peel and chop.
Mix with the mayonnaise and soy sauce until creamy.
Spoon onto two slices of bread and top with the remaining slices.
Butter the outsides and toast in a pan for 3 minutes a side, until golden and crisp.
notes: Food safety: boil eggs until firm; keep the filling cold until cooking and eat promptly.

recipes.title: Congee with Century-Free Soy Egg and Crisp Shallots
recipes.summary: Slow-cooked rice congee topped with soy-marinated eggs and crisp fried shallots.
steps: Combine the rice, water, ginger and 1 tsp salt in a large pot. Bring to the boil, then simmer on low for 45 minutes, stirring often, until thick and creamy.
Boil the eggs for 7 minutes until jammy, cool and peel, then steep in 2 tbsp soy sauce for 10 minutes.
Fry the thinly sliced shallots in the oil for 4 minutes until crisp and golden.
Ladle the congee into bowls and top with halved eggs, shallots, spring onion and remaining soy sauce.
notes: Food safety: boil eggs until the whites are firm.

recipes.title: Korean Egg and Kimchi Breakfast Rice Cakes
recipes.summary: Chewy rice cakes pan-fried with kimchi and topped with a runny egg.
steps: Soak the rice cakes in warm water for 10 minutes if firm, then drain.
Heat the sesame oil in a pan over medium heat. Fry the kimchi for 3 minutes until softened, then add the rice cakes and gochujang and toss for 5 minutes until chewy and glossy.
Make two wells and crack in the eggs, cover and cook for 2 minutes until the whites are set.
Scatter with spring onion and serve.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are set.

recipes.title: Thai Jok Style Pork Rice Porridge
recipes.summary: Smooth rice porridge with ginger and pork meatballs, finished with soy and spring onion.
steps: Simmer the rice and water with ginger and 1 tsp salt on low for 35 minutes, stirring often, until it breaks down into a thick porridge.
Mix the mince with 1 tbsp soy sauce and form into small balls.
Add the meatballs to the porridge and simmer for 8 minutes until cooked through (at least 75°C) and floating.
Crack in the eggs and stir for 2 minutes until just set in ribbons.
Ladle into bowls and top with spring onion and remaining soy sauce.
notes: Food safety: cook pork mince to 75°C and eggs until set; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.

recipes.title: Vietnamese Egg Coffee-Free Sticky Rice Breakfast Pots
recipes.summary: Sticky rice with peanuts and coconut for a filling start to the day.
steps: Rinse the rice, then simmer with the water and 1/2 tsp salt in a covered pot on low for 20 minutes until the water is absorbed and the grains are tender and sticky.
Toast the coconut for 3 minutes until golden and crush the peanuts roughly.
Mix the sugar through the rice, then divide into bowls and top with coconut and peanuts.
notes: Vegan.

recipes.title: Indian Egg Paratha Rolls with Mint Yoghurt
recipes.summary: Flaky flatbreads sealed with a spiced egg layer and served with cool mint yoghurt.
steps: Beat the eggs with the finely diced onion, chilli, garam masala and 1/2 tsp salt.
Heat the oil in a pan and cook the egg mixture in 3 batches for 2 minutes each until set.
Warm the parathas in a dry pan for 1 minute a side until crisp and golden.
Stir the mint into the yoghurt.
Roll an omelette in each paratha, drizzle with mint yoghurt and serve.
notes: Food safety: cook eggs until set.
